test_title: PYST 52: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

The company had some initial problems, but now it is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. 'flying high'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given phrase to be filled in the blank is an idiom which means performing very well or being successful.
 
 
• **Example: **After years of hard work, their business is finally flying high
